name: Mamiya Moeri
source:
What she calls the [url=/c38571]protagonist[/url]: Ryouta

The second daughter of the Mamiya quintuplets. Out of her siblings, she's the one with the most common sense, and acts quite often as the tsukkomi. She's good at taking care of others, but at school she shows her strict side as she's part of the discipline committee.

At Seamore, she does not only work as a waitress, but she's also in charge of the accounting.

Like her sisters, she also has a some kind of a kink related to Ryouta. Moeri is extremely attracted to Ryouta's scent, not to mention she loves masturbating and turns on pretty easily.
